To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

community sport can contribute to the creation of socio-cultural cohesion in divided communities, but that the perspectives of participants show that also political and economical dimensions of cohesion should be taken into account to understand the notion of community in community sport and in leisure more generally.
the participants in community sport in Flanders experienced socio-cultural cohesions, but also economic and political dimensions.
community is more than just socio-cultural cohesion and that community sport should be understood from an intersection between the political, economic and cultural dimensions of cohesion.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the question of how to understand the notion of cohesion and community sport in a divided community context, in which social cohesion and community are often used as a means to alleviate cultural segregation.
the lived experience of participants in community sport and their perspectives on the notion of cohesion.
the question if and to what extent leisure can contribute to the creation of social cohesion and can contribute to alleviate cultural segregation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
community sport is not only about socio-cultural cohesion, and that community cannot be limited to socio-cultural cohesion.
community sport can be a powerful tool in the creation of a cohesive society, but that this is not a given, as it is dependent on how the community sport is organised.
community sport is not the panacea to create social cohesion in divided community contexts, and that it is not the only form of leisure that can contribute to socio-cultural coherences.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the concept of cohesion in community sports needs a broader and deeper understanding.
community sport can be a powerful tool to promote socio-cultural cohesion, however it is not the only way to create a sense of community.
community sport can create a sense of community and socio-cultural cohesivness, but that it can also create a sense of political and economic cohesiveness.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the notion of cohesion is a useful lens to understand the experiences of participants, but that the concept should be redefined in order to better understand the lived experiences of community sport participants in relation to cohesion.
community sport can only create a sense of community when it addresses the different dimensions of cohesion, as they are experienced by the participants.
leisure can create socio-cultural cohesion in divided communities, but also political and economic cohesion.
